| description = The prince of [[Chardok]]. A rogue is required to lockpick the door. Can be managed with a single group. Torp shaman + chanter dps is highly recommended. Boltrans + torch on Royal Guards (no haste) works. The room can be pacified somewhat easily (on a lvl 60 w/ 255 cha). Notice that 'Selrach' is an anagram of Charles, hence the wordplay with royalty. Prince can be slowed somewhat easily with tash or malo. Consider pulling with dispell, since he will be buffed up from sorrounding mobs. 

CAN BE SNARED with Druid Epic! 10/6/25

01/09-2022 Confirmed Torpor drop
